start_here: Say to your AI: "Create a Hetzner DNS zone for example.com." It runs tool:create-a-hetzner-dns-zone with the zone name.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads or changes your Hetzner DNS zones.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI what to do, with the zone name and the record values.
2. The AI calls tools:run with the tool and its input.
3. Read the answer; a change is real, so check it with tool:read-hetzner-dns-rrsets.

worked_examples.title: Create a Hetzner DNS zone
worked_examples.ask: Create a Hetzner DNS zone for example.com.
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/hetzner-dns/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json: POST https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1/zones with the vault key hetzner-api-token as a bearer header, to api.hetzner.cloud only.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers the new zone's id and its Hetzner nameservers, for example id 42, with two nameserver names to set at the registrar.
